english_draft:
SK hynix reported 2Q26 results on July 29, 2026. Revenue was 79.3187 trillion won. Operating profit was 60.5426 trillion won. Net profit was 93.9226 trillion won. Operating margin was 76%. Net margin was 118%. These were record quarterly figures. DRAM and NAND prices rose sharply quarter over quarter. HBM4 mass shipments began in Q2. HBM4 production ramp is planned for H2. HBM4E completed sample shipments in H1. LTAs were finalized with about 10 customers. Cumulative H1 revenue exceeded 100 trillion won. Cash and equivalents reached 88 trillion won. Net cash was 69.4 trillion won. The company gave no explicit Q3 guidance. This preview is a historical reconstruction. It uses only the 2Q26 release.

Key questions for Q3: first, can AI memory price increases continue as HBM4 volume ramps? Second, how do LTAs affect price transmission? Third, will capacity investment and depreciation reduce operating margin? Positive scenarios include faster HBM4 ramp and more LTAs. Negative scenarios include fading price momentum and rising costs or depreciation.
reader_questions: 2Q26净利润率高达118%，净利显著高于营业利润；若主要来自非营业或税项项目，Q3是否应改用营业利润而非净利润作为核心跟踪指标？
HBM4虽已量产，但公告未披露其收入占比与长约价格条款；若HBM4以长约锁定出货，现货涨价对Q3收入的拉动是否会被高估？
321层NAND占比目标表述为产能而非出货；若转换为实际出货慢于产能爬坡，NAND对利润的贡献是否会滞后？
fact_checks: 核查日期与季度：来源为SK hynix于2026-07-29发布的2Q26业绩公告；本稿以该日为资料截止。
核查口径：所有财务数据为K-IFRS合并口径，来源表格单位为十亿韩元；公司明示为初步数字，可能经审计调整。
核查上季基准：1Q26营收52,576.3、营业利润37,610.3（十亿韩元），来自公告表格。
核查公司事实：HBM4于2Q26开始量产、下半年扩产，HBM4E上半年完成送样；LTAs与约10家客户敲定；321层NAND已占最大产量比重、年底目标为国内产能约50%；以上均为公告事实。
核查指引与共识：公告未提供2026Q3量化指引，也未包含市场共识；本稿中Q3情景均为推断，不是公司指引。
